expected_diagnosis: Backend response is slow enough to exceed proxy timeout.
recommended_next_checks: Check backend metrics, DB dependencies and slow requests.
resolution_guidance: Address backend bottleneck; do not just increase timeouts blindly.
verification: Normal peak traffic yields healthy latency and no 504.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
